source_name: ECB ERPB – Status Update on SCT Inst scheme and QR-code standardisation
why_relevant: Recurring ERPB status papers track instant-payment adherence shares by country and the European QR-code standardisation work that will interact with the Czech QR Platba/SPAYD standard.

source_name: e-banky.cz – Zdroje a primární prameny (ČNB, ČBA, NÚKIB, EBA) + QR Platba generator
why_relevant: Curated Czech link hub to primary payments/banking sources; useful snowballing shortcut and a working implementation reference for the ČBA QR standard.

source_name: Česká spořitelna – Výroční zpráva (annual report PDF series)
why_relevant: Largest CZ bank's annual report carries operational metrics not in any public register: number of active payment cards issued, credit cards, ATM/'platbomat' fleet size, branch count, digital channel users. 2025 edition reports ~4.4m active cards and 1,516 ATMs/deposit machines.

source_name: Česká spořitelna – Tiskové zprávy (press releases / results announcements)
why_relevant: Results press releases publish YoY deltas for cards, ATM count, mortgage volumes and digital users months before the full annual report; the Feb-2026 FY2025 release is the fastest route to card/ATM headline numbers.

source_name: Česká spořitelna – Dokumenty ke stažení / Povinné informace dle vyhlášky ČNB (Pillar 3 area)
why_relevant: Hosts the CNB-decree mandatory disclosures and Pillar 3 material; the structural home for recurring quarterly disclosure files, useful as a stable collection anchor even though card/ATM counts sit mainly in the annual report.

source_name: Erste Group Bank AG – Investor Relations (Czech Republic segment reporting)
why_relevant: Parent-level quarterly reports and presentations break out the Czech Republic segment (Česká spořitelna) with client counts, digital-user metrics and fee income splits, in English and on a faster cadence than the local Czech annual report.

source_name: Komerční banka – Annual Report (KB-Annual-Report-YYYY.pdf)
why_relevant: KB is PSE-listed, so its annual report is the richest voluntary disclosure of client counts, branch network, ATM fleet, card portfolio and digital-channel penetration among CZ banks; published in both CS and EN.

source_name: Komerční banka – Vztahy s investory / Investor Relations (quarterly results & presentations)
why_relevant: Quarterly results presentations are the highest-frequency actor-level source for CZ bank operational KPIs (client numbers, digital users, network size). Exact deep-link path unverified; treat as hypothesis pending liveness check.

source_name: Komerční banka – Tiskové zprávy (shared-ATM programme releases)
why_relevant: KB acts as the communications hub for the four-bank shared ATM/deposit-ATM alliance (KB, MONETA, Air Bank, UniCredit); these releases carry hard numbers on deposit-ATM counts and monthly cash-deposit transaction volumes/values — rare CZ cash-usage datapoints.

source_name: Sdílenýbankomat.cz – shared ATM alliance site
why_relevant: Dedicated joint site of the KB/MONETA/Air Bank/UniCredit shared ATM scheme; the operational locator behind the alliance and a route to fleet composition and coverage of the shared network.

source_name: Komerční banka – Branches and ATMs locator
why_relevant: Branch/ATM locators are the only actor-level, geocoded view of physical network footprint and can be counted over time to derive branch-closure and ATM-fleet trends that banks do not always disclose numerically.

source_name: ČSOB – Povinně uveřejňované informace
why_relevant: Central hub for ČSOB's annual reports, half-year reports and CNB-mandated disclosures; the stable entry point for group-level Czech data including client, digital-channel and network metrics.

source_name: ČSOB – results press releases (tiskové zprávy PDF, e.g. tz260212.pdf)
why_relevant: ČSOB's quarterly/annual results releases quantify digital-channel adoption (ČSOB Smart active mobile users ~1.58m, Kate assistant unique users) plus loan/deposit aggregates — the digital-payments-behaviour proxy for the second-largest CZ bank.

source_name: KBC Group – Quarterly Report (Czech Republic business unit)
why_relevant: KBC's quarterly report contains a dedicated Czech Republic business unit section with digital-sales and ecosystem metrics for ČSOB, in English, published ahead of the local Czech annual report.

source_name: MONETA Money Bank – Investor Relations (financial results & presentations)
why_relevant: MONETA is PSE-listed and publishes full quarterly result presentations with client, digital-user, card and network KPIs — the most granular quarterly actor-level dataset among CZ banks, in EN and CS.

source_name: MONETA – Sdílené bankomaty page
why_relevant: States the size of the shared ATM pool available to MONETA clients (~2,000 machines) and links the alliance locator — a direct CZ cash-infrastructure datapoint from the operator side.

source_name: Prague Stock Exchange (PSE/BCPP) – MONETA issuer page
why_relevant: Exchange issuer page aggregates regulated-information filings for the listed CZ banks (MONETA, KB), giving a dated, authoritative index of when each disclosure appeared — a scheduling backbone for actor-level collection.

source_name: UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia – Výroční zprávy / Pololetní zprávy
why_relevant: The only public route to UniCredit's Czech-entity operational and financial figures (the CZ+SK entity reports separately from UniCredit S.p.A.); annual reports now in ESEF/XHTML plus PDF, half-year reports available.

source_name: Raiffeisenbank a.s. (CZ) – Výroční zprávy / Výsledky hospodaření
why_relevant: Raiffeisenbank CZ (post Equa bank merger) publishes annual financial reports in ESEF plus an investor-information page; the only public route to its client, card and branch-network figures.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank International AG – Investor Relations (Czech subsidiary reporting)
why_relevant: RBI group quarterly reporting carries a Czech Republic segment line for Raiffeisenbank a.s., giving English-language, higher-frequency figures than the local annual report. URL inferred from group structure; unverified.

source_name: Air Bank a.s. – Konsolidovaná výroční zpráva (PDF series)
why_relevant: Air Bank (PPF group) is unlisted, so its consolidated annual report is the sole public source for client counts, card portfolio, deposit-ATM participation and digital metrics; FY2025 shows CZK 3.8bn consolidated net profit.

source_name: Fio banka, a.s. – Povinně uveřejňované informace + Výroční zpráva
why_relevant: Fio's quarterly mandatory-disclosure attachments plus the annual report are the only public route to its client base and card issuance (Visa/Mastercard dual-scheme retail model), relevant for the challenger-bank end of CZ card issuing.

source_name: ČNB – Přehled odkazů na webové stránky bank obsahující povinně uveřejňované informace
why_relevant: Regulator-maintained index mapping every CZ bank and foreign branch to its own mandatory-disclosure URL — the canonical, low-maintenance seed list for actor-level bank disclosure crawling, and the way to catch URL changes.

source_name: Peníze.cz / Finparáda – bank league tables by client numbers
why_relevant: Czech consumer-finance media aggregate bank-reported client counts and card/product changes into cross-bank league tables, filling gaps where unlisted banks (Air Bank, Fio) disclose irregularly; secondary but well-sourced and useful for triangulation.

source_name: Diebold Nixdorf - Banking Case Studies / Success Stories hub
why_relevant: Vendor case-study index that enumerates named bank customers and, unusually, hard fleet numbers (e.g. CSOB's 1,025 self-service devices, 99.8% uptime under DN AllConnect Managed Services). This is procurement and fleet-size intelligence that CZ banks do not publish themselves.

source_name: Diebold Nixdorf Investor Relations - press releases
why_relevant: Listed-vendor IR newsflow announcing product launches and named early adopters; the DN Series 300/350 launch names Komercni banka as first deployer at its Stodulky HQ. IR disclosure is materiality-tested, so it is more reliable than pure marketing.

source_name: ATM Marketplace - vendor/deployment news
why_relevant: Trade press that aggregates vendor win announcements and republishes deployment detail (e.g. Air Bank contactless CS 2020 rollout, ~160-terminal network expansion). Acts as a discovery layer for vendor press releases that never reach CZ media, and has per-company showcase pages (NCR Atleos etc.) that function as vendor newsfeeds.

source_name: KAL ATM Software - ATM news / industry insights
why_relevant: Multivendor ATM software supplier to Ceska sporitelna since 2016; its news items carry CZ fleet and channel statistics (over 1,600 ATMs, 550+ branches, ~5m customers; first CZ bank with QR cardless withdrawal; a '250th cash recycler' milestone at a Czech bank). Rare quantified detail on cash-recycling adoption in CZ.
